diff --git a/docs/notes/portable-context-release-review.md b/docs/notes/portable-context-release-review.md
index 0f01f65..6a15a49 100644
--- a/docs/notes/portable-context-release-review.md
+++ b/docs/notes/portable-context-release-review.md
@@ -14,3 +14,21 @@ session identity shape. No allowlist exception or weakened guard was introduced.
 Validation: the actual Node lockstep command failed before the correction and
 passes afterward; strict standalone TypeScript checking and the chat-module
 encapsulation guard pass. Full Console lint/test/build remains a separate gate.
+
+## Protocol conformance inventory
+
+The public fork conformance example stopped at its stale 152-method count after
+`sessions.reconcile_context` joined the canonical 153-method surface. The same
+independent suite also omitted the two retained-context refusal codes from its
+error inventory and HTTP 409 table. Added the named method and both named codes,
+keeping explicit independent expectations and exhaustive membership checks. The
+existing served recovery integration exercises real pending and unavailable
+evidence through the authenticated HTTP boundary; no fake recovery port or
+allowlist exception replaces that proof.
+
+Fresh validation on Go 1.26.4: complete conformance and public fork race suites
+pass; scoped pinned Go lint reports zero issues. Phase 269 smoke, including
+the disposable PostgreSQL service, passes 14 checks with no skips or failures.
+The broad repository run remains a separate incomplete gate: it reproduced the
+old fork inventory failure and exhausted the local memory limit in the served
+package. No test, coverage target or production timeout was weakened.
diff --git a/docs/notes/portable-context-tracker.md b/docs/notes/portable-context-tracker.md
index a2b1ad3..5b933ff 100644
--- a/docs/notes/portable-context-tracker.md
+++ b/docs/notes/portable-context-tracker.md
@@ -82,3 +82,12 @@ The [RC acceptance procedure](portable-context-rc.md) links the public-SDK
 editing sample and separates deterministic proof from live model evaluation.
 The sample checks actual persisted edits across separate invocations and exposes
 inspection without inference; live calls are never performed by its test suite.
+
+## Final-tree integration corrections
+
+The Console's hand-maintained reconciliation wire types are now explicit, with
+no untyped allowlist exception. The shared Protocol conformance inventory now
+includes the named recovery method and both HTTP 409 refusal codes; its exact
+counts and exhaustive membership checks remain independent. Phase 269 smoke
+also runs the public fork conformance consumer that caught the stale inventory.
+Full frontend and repository release gates remain separate acceptance above.

 	protoerrors.CodeRevisionConflict:                    http.StatusConflict,

 	protoerrors.CodeAgentPackCopyIdempotencyConflict:    http.StatusConflict,
@@ -548,6 +550,11 @@ var errorCodeMatrix = []protoerrors.Code{
 	// the conformance-suite scenario lands when the Stack wires the
 	// reopen-capable SessionEnsurer (same posture as CodeSessionRunning).
 	protoerrors.CodeSessionErased,

+	protoerrors.CodeRetainedContextUnsettled,

@@ -746,10 +753,10 @@ func RunSuite(t *testing.T, factory Factory) {
 func assertMethodMatrixExhaustive(t *testing.T) {
 	t.Helper()

-	// The canonical list currently contains 152 methods; keep the explicit

-	if len(got) != 152 {
-		t.Fatalf("conformance: methods.Methods() returned %d entries, expected 152 (including HA-68 skill publications and same-runtime Agent pack methods)", len(got))

 	}
 	wantSet := map[methods.Method]struct{}{
 		methods.MethodStart:               {},

 		methods.MethodAgentsForceStop:   {},

-		methods.MethodSessionsList:     {},

+		methods.MethodSessionsSetTitle:         {},

message:
fix(protocol): include retained reconciliation in conformance inventory

Keep independent exact method/error inventories current: 153 named methods and 40 refusal codes, including the two retained-context HTTP 409 outcomes. Extend phase 269 smoke with the public fork consumer; do not weaken checks.

Fresh Go 1.26.4 conformance/fork race suites and scoped pinned lint pass. Complete phase 269 smoke with disposable PostgreSQL passes 14 OK, 0 SKIP, 0 FAIL. Full repository validation remains pending; a broad run reproduced the stale inventory and later hit the local memory limit in serve. No RC or coverage-completion claim.
